relations.subject: Girindrasekhar Bose
relations.evidence: the first president (1922–1953) of the Indian Psychoanalytic Society

relations.subject: Girindrasekhar Bose
relations.evidence: Bose carried on a twenty-year dialogue with Sigmund Freud.

relations.subject: Girindrasekhar Bose
relations.evidence: he also started the first general hospital psychiatry unit (GHPU) in Asia at the R.G. Kar Medical College, Calcutta in 1933.

relations.subject: Girindrasekhar Bose
relations.evidence: He sent the thesis to Freud, which led to a correspondence between the two men and to the formation of the Indian Psychoanalytic Society in 1922 in Calcutta.
